clue.text: Around middle of afternoon, chef rings — 'send out for vinaigrette!'

taken as written

clue.text: What's this crib score worth if he loses badly?

explanation.walkthrough: In cribbage (crib) the dealer scores two points when the starter card turned up is a jack, called 'two for his heels'.
explanation.definitionFit: Two for his heels is the name of a particular two-point score in the card game cribbage.

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
